To Enforce Stipulated Judgment
Off Calendar Sep-24-2002 Off Calendar
MINI MINUTES: Judge Diane Wick, Dept. 611, Clerk, Beth Wilber, Reporter, Brenda Fields. c/c on calendar for a motion to enforce stipulated judgment. Reginald Bedell, Esq., appeared on behalf of plaintiff Wing Yui Gee. Gen Fujioka appeared on behalf of defendant Ching Chung Yang. Counsel established that defendant paid $3,381.88, and has not paid as agreed $3,381.88. Mr. Fujioka objects to the motion to enforce judgment stating he was not properly noticed. Court determines that the motion was not properly served. Case is off calendar. Plaintiff has to file a new motion.
